gen-nixie-one-gf-slabo-13px: One constant stroke runs through each Nixie One letter, curves left open. Slabo 13px brings a bookish dignity, its counters stand large and open, its lowercase tall, giving the retro-tech heading something sturdy to lean on.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-bhutuka-expanded-o: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, like cut-outs, all retro fun. It leans playful and spaced out, while BhuTuka Expanded One slows reading to a leisurely walk with curvy, literary letters.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-stint-ultra-expand: Playful from the first glyph, Press Start 2P hangs its letters far apart. It is best at light, retro fun, while Stint Ultra Expanded is best at authoritative, traditional text, each character floating free.
gen-righteous-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads authoritative and traditional, each character floating apart with counters opening outward. And Righteous fills the line with bowls of thin bent steel, so the fun, commanding heading is what sticks.
gen-silkscreen-gf-hanuman: Spaghetti lines, lo-fi and retro, with Silkscreen leaving room around every letter. Then Hanuman steps in, traditional and refined, its high-waisted lowercase giving the page something steadier to read.
gen-silkscreen-gf-kadwa: Retro through and through, Silkscreen spaces every letter apart like spaghetti laid out in letters, lo-fi to the bone. Kadwa brings editorial polish, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height.
gen-silkscreen-gf-noticia-text: The body text reads literary and dignified, a sharp turn from Silkscreen's lo-fi wire lines. Noticia Text fills most of its letter height with lowercase, and that sturdy bulk against wire lines is the best thing here.
gen-silkscreen-gf-scope-one: Scope One lets its counters spill into the surrounding space. Bring its size up a notch beneath Silkscreen, and the stubby ascenders and descenders settle in beside the big x-height.
gen-silkscreen-gf-suwannaphum: Silkscreen scatters its lo-fi, retro letters with space around each one that you can almost feel, all wire and no hairlines. Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, with high x-height giving paragraphs a squared-off stride.
gen-tourney-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Bold, athletic, stretched wide: Tourney cuts every stroke uniform and tracks its words far apart. Tourney brings the muscle, but Padyakke Expanded One carries the literary, authoritative voice, its glyphs spread like knots on a slack rope.
